probe_hopping_unit: t2=1; tau is the sample-to-probe hopping, not Gamma
probe_gamma: Gamma_p(E)=tc_p^2*sqrt(4-E^2) for the shared probe reservoir with hopping1
unequal_path: tc3=tau,tc4=tau/2 at EF=.1; both vanish together
kappa_conversion: dimensionless paper kappa=-historical kH_code/4 exactly once
bare_prediction: kappa_DOS=-d_E ln(rho_top/rho_bottom)/8; kappa_injectivity=(d_V eta_top-d_V eta_bottom)/2; total=sum
finite_probe_contact_rho: nu_L+nu_R at actual sample contact atom; excludes probe-origin injection
finite_probe_eta_drive: physical source +/-V/2 plus solved linear floating probe potentials; sample shift -V*field_code/2
finite_contact_mapping: kappa=[-Delta(dE_ln_rho)/8+Delta(dV_eta)/2]/[1+T34*(1/F3+1/F4)], from probe-dressed contact quantities, not the bare two-port predictor
electrostatics: First-order local neutrality, no full Poisson/Hartree; coherent zero-temperature calculation
same_probe_reservoir_cancellation: The shared spectral function cancels from the Hall logarithmic ratio even for constant unequal tc3/tc4; both must become weak.

release_portability.note: File paths relocated for the public package. Numeric datasets and historical numerical/source hashes are unchanged. historical_sources entries document unavailable prior generators, not runtime dependencies.
